abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: View the My ORDERS list in the signed-in account
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: View the My ORDERS list in the signed-in account
Module: My Account > Order History
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- Customer is signed in as "Leslie Alexander"
- The My Account > Order History page is open

Test Steps:
1. Check the app chrome: "Fine Jewellery", "Wedding & Engagement", "Forever diamonds", "About us", "Contact us", "2", "USD" is visible
2. Check that the "Home" button and the "My ORDERS" heading are visible
3. Check that "Hi, Leslie Alexander" is visible
4. Check that the account menu shows "My Account Settings", "My Orders", "Address Book" and "Sign Out"
5. Check that the list header shows the columns "Order No.", "Total", "Payment mode", "Order Status" and "Order Placed"
6. Check that each order row shows an order number, a total, a payment mode, a status, a date and a "View details" link
7. Check that the text "Showing 1-6 of 12 items" is visible
8. Check that the "Load More" button is visible
9. Scroll to the footer and check that the "Explore", "The Company", "Social" and "Legal" sections and "© 2024 MIKI JEWEL All rights reserved" are visible

Expected Result:
- The app chrome is visible on the screen
- "Home" and "My ORDERS" are visible
- The greeting "Hi, Leslie Alexander" is visible
- All four account menu items are visible
- All five column headers are visible
- Every order row shows the order number, total (currency format), payment mode, status, date and "View details"
- "Showing 1-6 of 12 items" is visible
- "Load More" is visible
- The footer sections and copyright line are visible

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Browse from the Home Page to a ring, check the size guide, buy it and go through the shopping bag to checkout
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Browse from the Home Page to a ring, check the size guide, buy it and go through the shopping bag to checkout
Module: Jewellery shopping: browse, Size Guide, shopping bag and checkout
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- The prototype is open on the Home Page.

Test Steps:
1. Look at the Home Page.
2. Look at the header: "Fine Jewellery", "Wedding & Engagement", "Forever diamonds", "About us", "Contact us", "2" and "USD".
3. Click the "Fine Jewellery" tab in the header.
4. Click "Best Seller Rings Classic Leaves Diamond Ring $68".
5. Click "Size Guide".
6. Click "Measure My Finger".
7. Click "Measure My Own Ring".
8. Click the close button (labelled "2").
9. Click "Buy Now".
10. Look at the shopping bag: the items, "Subtotal", "Total" and "Estimated Shipping".
11. Click "Checkout".
12. Look at the Delivery Address, Order details and Payment Method sections.
13. Click "Cart".
14. Click "Home".

Expected Result:
- The Home Page shows "Featured Collections", "Our Best Sellers" and "Shop Diamonds by shape" with the buttons Round, Oval, Emerald, Cushion, Pear, Radiant, Princess, Marquise, Asscher and Heart.
- All header items are visible.
- The Fine Jewellery Page opens. It shows the categories Earrings, Rings, Necklaces and Bracelets, the Categories, Price and Metal & Stone filters, and the product list.
- The Product Details page for "Classic Leaves Diamond Ring" opens. It shows the price "$68", the sizes 4 to 10, "Size Guide", "Add to Cart" and "Buy Now".
- The Size Guide (Measure My Own Ring) screen opens with the Instructions and a table with the columns Internal Diameter (mm), US/CAN, UK/AUS and German.
- The Size Guide (Measure My Finger) screen opens with the paper-strip Instructions, a table with the columns Circumference (mm) and US/CAN, and "Tips On How To Measure".
- The Size Guide (Measure My Own Ring) screen with the internal-diameter table shows again.
- The Product Details page for "Classic Leaves Diamond Ring" shows again.
- The Shopping Bag page opens.
- The Shopping Bag page shows the bag items with size and material details, a "Remove" option, "Subtotal", "Total" and "Estimated Shipping".
- The Check Out page opens.
- The Check Out page shows "Delivery Address", "Order details" with "Subtotal" and "Total", and "Payment Method".
- The Shopping Bag page shows again.
- The Home Page shows again.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Complete the evolving application workflow from Sprint 1 to Iteration 5 and submit
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Complete the evolving application workflow from Sprint 1 to Iteration 5 and submit
Module: Automation Page - Evolving Application Workflow
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- A browser is available and https://ultimateqa.com/automation/ is reachable

Test Steps:
1. Open the URL https://ultimateqa.com/automation/ in the browser.
2. Wait until the text "Learn how to automate an application that evolves over time" is visible.
3. Click on "Learn how to automate an application that evolves over time".
4. Wait until the text "Sprint 1" is visible.
5. Type "FirstDemo" in the Firstname text field.
6. Click on "Go to next sprint".
7. Wait until the text "Iteration 2" is visible.
8. Type "FirstDemo" in the Firstname field.
9. Type "LastDemo" in the Lastname field.
10. Click on "Go to sprint 3".
11. Wait until the text "Iteration 3" is visible.
12. Click on the "Male" radio button.
13. Type "FirstDemo" in the Firstname field.
14. Type "LastDemo" in the Lastname field.
15. Click on "Go to sprint 4".
16. Wait until the text "Iteration 4" is visible.
17. Click on "Go to sprint 5".
18. Wait until the text "Iteration 5" is visible.
19. Click on the "Submit" button.

Expected Result:
- The Automation page loads and the "Learn how to automate an application that evolves over time" text is visible.
- Clicking the text opens Sprint 1.
- "FirstDemo" is accepted in the Firstname field and "Go to next sprint" opens Iteration 2.
- Firstname and Lastname accept "FirstDemo" and "LastDemo", and "Go to sprint 3" opens Iteration 3.
- The "Male" radio button is selected, the text fields accept the values, and "Go to sprint 4" opens Iteration 4.
- "Go to sprint 5" opens Iteration 5.
- Clicking "Submit" in Iteration 5 submits the form successfully.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Move from Iteration 3 to Iteration 4 without selecting the Male radio button

Priority: Medium

- The story defines the expected flow only with "Male" selected and does not describe rejection behaviour.
